text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Uma Musume presents a new TCG,
Uma Duel Racers! In this brand new game,
you can collect cards of Uma 
Musume around the world and become a champion
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They're hosting a card game here for 
the game too! Hehe, doesn't it sound fun?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It really does!
I just bought myself a new deck, 
so it'll be a great chance for me to play.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's so like you to have us come to a 
tournament so soon after starting the
game.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Satono!
We're going to be rival duelers today! 
If we face each other,
we've gotta go all out!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Uma Duel Racers morning tournament 
will now begin. Our contestants will be—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature!
The winner gets a year's supply of 
carrot chips.
If I win I'll share some with you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah yeah, I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I looost!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Card games sure are difficult… I wish I 
could've won more with the McQueen deck.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dia… they're still allowing people to
register for 
the afternoon tournament.
Mind if I borrow your deck?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's fine,
but… are you really going register?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna enter?! Wait, but didn't 
you just recently find out about this
game?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I pretty much figured it all out from Dia
and Turbo's duel, 
so don't worry about that.
I'm going to avenge you two!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Dia, I'll show you how powerful 
your deck really is. I'm confident♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I summon Uma Musume: Mejiro McQueen!
I then 
activate my tactical card,
Noble Obligation! And that's Goal!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's finished! The duel is over! 
The winner is Satono Crown! 
She finished with over 1 billion Race
Points!! 
She's the undisputed champion!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Crown is so amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She actually managed to win? I guess rich 
smart girls shouldn't be underestimated,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ Crown's always been like this. 
She grows stronger in the face of
adversity.

text_block_list.name: Fanboy
text_block_list.text:
That duel was incredible! 
How do I become as good a duel racer as
you?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's better to learn by doing rather 
than having it told to you. Wanna duel me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a champion faces against a 
future competitor… what a great story.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I lost…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Really?! After all that?!
Are you cursed to never 
win matches you absolutely should be
winning?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! Cheer up! At least you've 
got a bunch of carrot chips now!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what I do is none of your business, 
so don't worry about it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I said it's fine. Just… 
leave me alone. We'll talk later.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa… I guess I'll go do some fishing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I may have said that to Sis, but maybe \Nshe has a point. I haven't done what I can…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should be doing more joint training sessions or something. Well, even if I wanted to, I have no friends to do it with…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Is that you,
Cheval-chan?! What a coincidence! I 
came to do some fishing with the upper
classmen!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: She ended up dragging me into this too…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aagh! Why can't I fish up anything?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Nngh… When I came with Sei-chan, 
we managed to catch a lot of fish. 
Why can't we catch any today…?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: The way they move their rod is- No, someone like me shouldn't say something so rude to members of the Golden Generation of Uma Musume…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I think I've got it! Teio-san, Spe-san,
you 
shouldn't move your rods so much!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Woah… Kita-san doesn't seem intimidated whatsoever by them… if only I was like her…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan! What else do you 
think they should be doing?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-Why're you asking me?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well you looked like a real pro when you
casted 
your rod earlier!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I agree! Your movements looked so refined,
like 
you've done this many times!
I'd love to hear 
some tips from you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No, I think you girls have the wrong—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Woah♪ As soon as we did what you 
said, we started catching loads 
of fish! You're incredible!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What a great haul♪ Cheval,
you're amazing! A 
true fishing genius!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Th-That's not true… not one bit…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trust us,
you're really amazing! Thanks for 
today!
Let's go fishing together again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan, I'm home♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Welcome home, Kita-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my friends,
today was a lot of fun.
